overview_description.description: Hyperbrowser provides serverless cloud browser infrastructure designed for AI agents, automated web scraping, and browser-based testing workflows. The platform offers an API-driven headless browser grid with integrated residential proxy rotation, fingerprint management, and CAPTCHA solving to reduce anti-bot detection issues. Hyperbrowser supports frameworks such as Playwright, Puppeteer, and Selenium, enabling teams to migrate existing scripts with minimal changes. Its tooling includes collaborative remote debugging, trace viewing, and credit-based pricing that separates browser compute from proxy data usage. Hyperbrowser also offers open-source and sandboxed runtimes that give AI agents controlled access to terminal and filesystem environments. Customers use the platform to run large numbers of concurrent browser sessions for data extraction, regression testing, and complex multi-step automation tasks.
